criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the GitLab Runner Releases page and view the list of releases without signing in. Full credit if the releases list is accessible and browsed while remaining logged out. Full credit also if access is blocked by an uncontrollable issue (e.g., GitLab outage, CAPTCHA/rate-limit wall, mandatory login prompt, or critical content fails to load due to site/JS issues) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted (e.g., refresh, alternate browser view).

From the first displayed releases, open the first release whose tag has no prerelease suffix (exclude release-candidate/rc, beta, alpha, and any other prerelease tags). Full credit if the chosen release is the earliest in the displayed order that meets the non-prerelease constraint. If the page shows only prerelease tags in the visible list or the tag suffix information is not visible due to UI/loading issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports that no qualifying release is observable and explains the limitation; partial credit if a later qualifying non-prerelease is opened when an earlier qualifying one is visible.

Report the selected release’s tag and the exact created date as displayed on the release page. Full credit for both values exactly matching the UI. If the created date field is not displayed/accessible due to UI changes, localization differences, or loading issues, full credit if the agent provides the tag and clearly states that the created date is not visible and why; partial credit if one of the two is correct or if the date is approximate relative to what is displayed.

In the Assets section, locate the 'Other' subsection and record the first three link names shown there, preserving the displayed order, explicitly excluding Source code archives (e.g., zip/tar.gz), and without downloading assets. Full credit if exactly the first three 'Other' asset-link names (non-source archives) are captured in order. If the 'Other' subsection is missing/collapsed/unavailable, or if fewer than three non-source 'Other' links exist for that release, full credit if the agent records all available qualifying 'Other' links (or reports that none exist beyond source archives) and clearly explains the limitation. Partial credit if only 1–2 correct links are recorded when 3 are available, if order is wrong, or if a source code archive is mistakenly included.
